details:
We're seeking an experienced Senior Java Engineer to join a leading financial services organisation on a 12-month contract, working across customer and data platforms.
What you'll do
Design, build, and support cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP
Develop secure, high-performance APIs and microservices
Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless technologies
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices (CI/CD, DevOps, Agile)
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a collaborative team culture
What we're looking for
7+ years in complex technology environments
Strong backend experience (Java, Kotlin, NodeJS, or Python)
Solid cloud engineering skills (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines and containerisation
Familiarity with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Nice to have
Terraform/CloudFormation experience
Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP)
Insurance or financial services background
�� Sydney / Brisbane / Melbourne based (hybrid)
⏳ 12-month contract | Competitive daily rate
